title: Chart localization: ∫_M g = 0 when the Jacobian-weighted pullback of g is the divergence of a field vanishing off the chart preimage of a compact set
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W K : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (g : Rn N → ℝ) (w : Rn n → Rn n), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → MeasurableSet M → IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → (∀ y ∈ M, y ∉ K → g y = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w V → (∀ x ∈ V, ψ x ∉ K → w x = 0) → (∀ x ∈ V, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (fderiv ℝ w x).toLinearMap = Chapter02.areaJacobianAt ψ x * g (ψ x)) → ∫ y in M, g y ∂μHE[n] = 0
